info.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
info.synopsis: Il fidanzamento fra Scarlet ed il secondo principe Kyle è stato improvvisamente annullato durante un ballo. Falsamente accusata di aver molestato Tenerezza, la figlia di un barone che era particolarmente adorata da Kyle, viene condannata da tutte le famiglie aristocratiche che iniziano ad incolparla per ogni genere di crimine. Dopo aver sopportato per anni gli abusi e l'idiozia del principe, ora la ragazza ha raggiunto il suo limite. "Prima di andarmene, posso chiederti un ultimo favore?" chiese prima di dare un pugno in faccia a Kyle. Così inizia la storia di vendetta di Scarlett, una combattente elegante ma ribelle che non ha più intenzione che qualcuno si approfitti di lei!

episodes.title: May I Kindly Beat the Tar Out of Those Evil Nobles (Pigs)?
episodes.synopsis: When "villainess" Scarlet's fiancé dumps her at a ball, she requests an unexpected form of satisfaction.

episodes.title: May I Offer You the Taste of My Fist as the Ladylike Thing to Do?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet's behavior at the ball has unexpected consequences, including a direct attempt on her life!

episodes.title: I Considered a Negotiated Resolution, but May I Biff and Pow Those Noblemen Instead?
episodes.synopsis: To take down the kingdom's slave trader, Scarlet negotiates access to the upcoming slave auction.

episodes.title: May I Go to See My Fists` Beloved One (Punching Bag)?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet infiltrates the slave auction, but her priority is to find and pummel Lord Godwin.

episodes.title: May I Clobber This Asshole Prince?
episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of the slave auction raid, Scarlet and Julius consider their next moves.

episodes.title: May I Send This Pig Flying into the Sky?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet is to accompany Saint Diana's Holy Land Pilgrimage, but the servants of Palmianism stand in her way.

episodes.title: May I Carry Out a Plan That Shows a New Side of You?
episodes.synopsis: Diana explores new feelings while Scarlet explores a festival looking for new people to punch.

episodes.title: May I Offer You a Fist in Place of a Handkerchief?
episodes.synopsis: The pilgrimage proceeds to Snowind, where Scarlet and her crew receive a less than warm welcome.

episodes.title: May I Explain That This Is Not Something That Just Anyone Can Do?
episodes.synopsis: While threats approach from all sides, Diana is racked with guilt over Scarlet's condition.

episodes.title: May I Cook This Thick Cut of Pork Through with Body Punches?
episodes.synopsis: Julius negotiates with an unexpected ally while Scarlet hones her fists for a new kind of feast.

episodes.title: As These Appear Undercooked, May I Turn Them Into Mince Meat?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet and her friends continue to deal with the external threats, but the source of the problem remains.

episodes.title: May I Pay Off the Massive Debt My Fists Have Accrued?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet pursues a final reckoning with Terenezza, but the would-be heroine has a cruel plan in store.

episodes.title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
episodes.synopsis: Scarlet is ready to deal her last punch to Terenezza, but she must first overcome a mind-controlled Julius.

info.title: Mahoromatic: I'm Home!
info.synopsis: Suguru e i suoi compagni di classe si preparano per un maid café per celebrare l’anniversario della città. Nel frattempo, Minawa viene attaccata da dei robot. Mahoro cerca di salvare Minawa e di aiutare Suguru e i suoi compagni a preparare il maid café.

episodes.title: The Returning Wind
episodes.synopsis: While Mahoro is teaching everyone how to be a maid for their new store Cafe Trois, Minowa is attacked by the robots from Management.

episodes.title: The Returning Sky
episodes.synopsis: As Mahoro helps out at Cafe Trois on the opening day, she senses danger. When the robot henchmen close in, Mahoro rushes to Minowa's aid.

info.title: High School! Kimengumi (2026)
info.synopsis: L'eccentrico e selvaggio Kimengumi torna nell'era Reiwa con la sua commedia giovanile ad altissima energia!

episodes.title: Enter Kimengumi!
episodes.synopsis: Yui Kawa has just transferred to Class 3-5 at Ichio Junior High. According to her seatmate, Chie Uru, this school is home to many oddballs-some of them, in particular, the "oddest among all oddballs": five individuals with extraordinary appearances and equally extraordinary personalities, known as Kimengumi. Chasing after these unruly characters, Yui's unpredictable school life begins!

episodes.title: New Semester: The Ultimate Self-Introduction / A Battle Without Rules: Classmates United
episodes.synopsis: In the blink of an eye, the cast blows up-well, graduates from- Ichio Junior High and moves on to the next stage: Ichio High School! As the usual crew and a colorful group of new classmates gather, Rei is the only one missing…? / Yui, Kimengumi, and their classmates head to a bowling alley on a day off. A sudden bowling match kicks off, and Yui herself somehow ends up as the prize…?

episodes.title: The Gag Effect of Kindness!? / Blessings for the Contrarian
episodes.synopsis: Chie is furious with Yui, and the cause seems to be one of Yui's meddlesome remarks. Rei, who bumps into the furious Chie, starts talking to her about how kindness can backfire… / Jako Amano, the leader of Omegumi, is a contrarian. Both students and teachers tend to avoid her, as she always finds fault in everything, and Jako herself is well aware of this too, but still…

episodes.title: Leap Through Time! The Hot-Blooded Teacher / Dai Monohoshi, Do You Have Any Backbone in You?
episodes.synopsis: The freewheeling-as-usual Class 1-5 welcomes a new vice homeroom teacher today! Dreaming of becoming a passionate teacher in the old-school, Showa-era way, Mr. Jidai is left stunned by Kimengumi's eccentricity. / Wakazo Temekono, the school gang leader at Ichio High School, is searching for a successor. Spotting Dai, he sets out to toughen Dai up, only to find himself completely toyed with instead…

episodes.title: Don Harumage the Nemesis Approaches! / Let`s Play Somewhere in the Universe
episodes.synopsis: Kimengumi, Yui, and Chie visit Rei's house to hang out. In Rei's childhood photo album, they notice a boy who appears beside Rei in every picture…? Rei's fated rival, Don Harumage, enters the fray! / Don struggles to fit in with his new class as a transfer student. One stormy day, Don and Rei come across a mysterious creature. Naming it Pochi, the two bring the creature to school, but…

episodes.title: Shy Boy Go / Please Tell Me All About Marriage
episodes.synopsis: Chie is taking time off from school after breaking her leg. As the girls discuss visiting the injured Chie, Go, who is watching from afar, seems to have something on his mind… / Ms. Ikari and Mr. Sessa are getting married!? While the teachers aren't exactly displeased by the excitement among the students, they can't help worrying about Kimengumi, who have been invited to the wedding after-party…

episodes.title: Kiri`s Hide-and-Seek Wars! / Kiyoshi Syusse: A Pervert No Matter What
episodes.synopsis: Kiri Ichido is a straight-A honor student, but her perfect image is now at risk because of a home visit! The Ichido family is full of people she can't bring herself to introduce to her homeroom teacher…/Sho Kireide, leader of Irootokogumi, is as popular as ever. Meanwhile, Kiyoshi has just had his heart broken by what felt like love at first sight.

episodes.title: Seaside Chase / A Midsummer Night`s Poppin` Shower
episodes.synopsis: Yui and the girls head to the beach. The members of Udegumi are also there, apparently working part-time. Suddenly, something rises from the calm sea…it's Ja●s and the Umibozu!? / Kimengumi is so thrilled about the summer fireworks festival that the teachers' warning-"Don't go overboard!"-falls on deaf ears. However, Go has to help out at home that day…

episodes.title: Sleepy Bug Jin / About Your Cooking...
episodes.synopsis: Today is just another ordinary day for the Daima family, as Jin's parents try every possible way to wake him up. They somehow manage to send him off, but Jin's laid-back attitude doesn't stop, even after he gets to school. / Yui comes to school acting strange. The reason is that Rei showed up in her dream that morning. Meanwhile, Rei also seems to have something he wants to tell Yui…?

episodes.title: Let`s Go on a School Trip
episodes.synopsis: The students at Ichio High School are off on a school trip! Rumor has it that an extremely fancy dinner awaits them in the evening. Unfortunately, the leaders of each group are left behind as the bus departs! By the time they finally make it to the hotel, the dinner has already been completely eaten.

episodes.title: Chara-llel World
episodes.synopsis: Yui is with Rei on their usual way to school. When they arrive at school, everyone seems to act different from usual. As they grow confused at the unfamiliar Chie and the members of other groups, another Yui and Rei appear!? What's more, their alternate versions have entirely different personalities and do not seem to get along at all…

episodes.title: Kimengumi Back in the Day
episodes.synopsis: Seeing the small park nearby, Kimengumi and Chie get excited as they reminisce about their childhood, and Yui can't help but feel a little envious. The group then decides to watch one of Rei's videos titled "I Ran an Errand Today!".

info.title: High Speed Jessie
info.synopsis: Jecy è un giovane in cerca di vendetta; ha perso i genitori per mano del sindacato criminale organizzato chiamato Bismark House - un gruppo a caccia di un prodotto chiamato "lyzorium" a qualsiasi costo. Con incredibili abilità come velocità e agilità aumentate, Jecy viaggia attraverso lo spazio con una ragazza di nome Tiana; Fork Green, un prete della religione Heartland che uccide i criminali lentamente per mandarli in paradiso; e una nave vivente chiamata Paolon. Tuttavia, la vendetta di Jecy non sarà facile - una donna di nome Jera, il suo fratellino assetato di sangue Cross e numerosi altri avversari gli sbarrano la strada!

episodes.title: Prologue
episodes.synopsis: Night in the city, and some local thugs are on the prowl. A priest of Hartland catches them and is vetting out justice. But before he can act, Jecy intervenes, catching the attention of a mysterious woman. But her offer of a job later ends up more than he bargained for. With his companion Tiana hostage, completing a dangerous task is Jecy's only means to rescue her.

info.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm (ITA)
info.synopsis: Yuru vive in un piccolo villaggio in montagna, conducendo una vita serena vivendo di caccia di uccelli. Mentre la sorella gemella di Yuru stranamente sembra avere un "compito" nella prigione del villaggio come se fosse intrappolata. Un mistero viene fuori in questo villaggio apparentemente sereno, cosa si nasconde dietro?

episodes.title: Asa and Yuru
episodes.synopsis: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

episodes.title: Left and Right
episodes.synopsis: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

episodes.title: Dera and Hana
episodes.synopsis: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

episodes.title: Jin and Yuru
episodes.synopsis: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

episodes.title: Hare and Tortoise
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
episodes.synopsis: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

episodes.title: Asa and Break
episodes.synopsis: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

episodes.title: Suspicion and Conviction
episodes.synopsis: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they're invited to breakfast by the clan head.

episodes.title: Embrace and Whisper
episodes.synopsis: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.

episodes.title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
episodes.synopsis: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they’re being followed.

episodes.title: Big Brother and Little Brother
episodes.synopsis: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

episodes.title: Retainer and Shaman
episodes.synopsis: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

episodes.title: Daikyo and Shokyo
episodes.synopsis: Higashi Village is attacked by a man wielding katana Daemons.

episodes.title: Family and Friends
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

episodes.title: Yuru and Danji
episodes.synopsis: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

episodes.title: Kagemori and Shingo
episodes.synopsis: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

episodes.title: Crybaby and Naughty Child
episodes.synopsis: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

episodes.title: Fujin and Raijin
episodes.synopsis: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

episodes.title: Sword and Bow
episodes.synopsis: Asa rescues the hostages, and Yuru faces off against Ivan.

episodes.title: The Hunted and the Hunter
episodes.synopsis: After an intense battle, Ivan escapes. He teleports back to Shingo, who appears to be in trouble.

episodes.title: Zashiki-Warashi and Higashi Village
episodes.synopsis: The Zashiki-Warashi, Danji and Kiri, tell Asa and Yuru what they know about Higashi Village.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
episodes.synopsis: Natsuki demands to know why Akio betrayed the Kagemori clan, but he offers no explanation.

episodes.title: Emotion and Reason
episodes.synopsis: Akio escapes from the Kagemoris, and Yuru comes down with a fever.

episodes.title: Higashi Village and Nishino Village
episodes.synopsis: Yuru dreams about the day bandits tried to kill him as a kid, and Asa blames herself for the gardener's death.

info.title: My Hero Academia: More (ITA)
info.synopsis: Special animato in cui viene raccontata la storia di Deku e degli amici dopo l'episodio finale. Le vicende sono state pubblicate da Kohei Horikoshi nel 42° e ultimo volume del manga originale.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis: Time has passed, and the former members of Class 1-A have grown up, but something is bothering Uraraka...

info.title: Shuten Doji - The Star Hand Kid (ITA)
info.synopsis: La storia segue le vicende di Jiro Shutendo, un ragazzo che scopre di essere la reincarnazione del mitologico demone Shutendoji. Sospeso tra la sua natura umana e una spaventosa eredità demoniaca, Jiro si ritrova a dover combattere oscure minacce in un mix di horror, mitologia giapponese e fantascienza.

episodes.title: Chapter of Hyoki
episodes.synopsis: A huge oni arrives on Earth carrying a precious cargo: a baby boy, which he leaves with a young human couple with the instructions that they are to raise him as their own until the oni returns in 15 years.

episodes.title: Chapter of Goma
episodes.synopsis: Jiro gets attacked at some temple and a bunch of new characters show up to help him. This new team escapes and returns to Jiro's house for introductions, not that this matters since his mom and Miyuki get kidnapped and they have to rush to the rescue.

episodes.title: Chapter of Tekki
episodes.synopsis: Jiro's mom has gone insane over the loss of her boy and is sent to a mental institution. Jiro and the rest are in some dimension being attacked by Oni of all colours and Jiro ends up in space while the rest end up in ancient Japan.

episodes.title: The Forgotten Past
episodes.synopsis: An adoptive father, an old photo, and the day two powers first crossed paths.

episodes.title: The Caged Beast
episodes.synopsis: Searching for Xia Fei means going where no one looks. That has never stopped Cheng Xiaoshi.

episodes.title: Bloodbath in Laos
episodes.synopsis: Faced with a crisis, can Cheng Xiaoshi save Xia Fei, or will help come from someone else?

episodes.title: Jae
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious visitor from Bridon disrupts the photo studio's peace. What has he come for?

episodes.title: Welcome Banquet
episodes.synopsis: Over a steaming hot pot feast, rival factions quietly begin to clash.

episodes.title: Testing the Waters
episodes.synopsis: A forgotten childhood photo resurfaces in a test across time and space. But who is the real prey?

episodes.title: Chinatown Investigation
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi possesses a young Vein and encounters Xia Fei's father in Chinatown, uncovering a cruel truth.

episodes.title: Blood-Red Storm
episodes.synopsis: The secret behind the Chinatown family massacre.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.synopsis: Xia Fei's intentions are revealed, along with Lu Guang's motives.

episodes.title: Misplaced Redemption
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi relives lost memories and discovers that the past he wants to save is already broken.

episodes.title: The Exit Disappears
episodes.synopsis: Cheng Xiaoshi jumps between photos as the paths back to the present close one by one.

episodes.title: Welcome Home
episodes.synopsis: Trapped between memories and photographs, Cheng Xiaoshi searches for a way back.
